Wrote `docs/research/strata/psp-loader-open-questions.md` (833 B, ~93 words) from the single declared source.

**Verified loader behavior:** size must equal the caller `file_size`, bad IDs and NULL pointers fail, header size stays inside the array offset and file size, ucode size is non-zero and fits after the offset, RLC_G is gated to rlc v2.0 with later minors refused, CRC32 and version fields are unchecked, MEC1/MEC2 require gfx major 1 with JT size and offset under a quarter of ucode, CP_MEC1/2 take the remainder while JT halves take the quarter slice, and SDMA0/1, CE, PFP, ME and RLC_G use the whole ucode.

**Unanswered PS5 questions:** container framing, RLC minor plus restore/IRAM/DRAM images, PSP IP fit with `psp_v11_0_8.c` ring semantics, MEC jump table semantics, CRC32 checking, and endianness. All are unmeasured hypotheses.
